reasons.specificity: The lanes distinguish political support, regulation, R&D, industrial finance, venture capital, and publication metadata with source-specific actors, dates, precision, and status.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly all substantive claims are supported by matching passages, though several purportedly verbatim ledger anchors are visibly truncated and the continuous bipartisan-support interval is synthesized from separated statements.
reasons.non_obviousness: It usefully distinguishes point events from intervals, proposals from enactments, promises from disbursements, publication dates from event dates, and contextual linkage from synchronization.
reasons.coherence: The cautious overlap logic is internally consistent, but F13–F15 appear only in the ledger rather than the process lanes while the scope assessment nevertheless asserts complete coverage.
reasons.usefulness: The tables make the chronology and evidentiary limits easy to inspect and correctly prevent causal inference from mere temporal overlap, despite omitting several useful dated developments.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Most claims are bounded and accurate, but unsupported assertions of complete coverage and of corrected/full verbatim anchors create avoidable overclaiming.

decisive_errors.analysis_claim: The scope assessment repeatedly reports lane and overlap coverage as “complete.”
decisive_errors.counter_passage: The source contains additional clearly dated events—including “On 26 April 2023” GWEO funding, “In July 2023” Hanwha’s preferred-bidder selection, and “In October 2022” Lockheed Martin’s investment—which F13–F15 themselves record but the parallel-lanes and overlap tables omit.
decisive_errors.why_decisive: The artifact is presented as a completed process inventory, so claiming completeness while excluding even ledgered events is a material coverage and coherence error.

score.one_line: A strong, carefully bounded temporal reading with excellent source-specific distinctions, weakened by false completeness claims and incomplete integration of its own findings into the requested lanes and overlap inventory.
